speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) is committed to creating opportunities for Singaporeans by helping businesses and workers adapt to a changing world economy.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will not return to the pre-COVID-19 world.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We must chart a path forward together in a very different future.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The geopolitical environment which allowed Singapore to thrive over the past 50 years has changed.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We face the prospect of a fragmented world, marked by tensions between the major powers, uneasy trade relations, and bifurcated technological standards.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The merits of free trade and global integration have been increasingly questioned.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The increased tensions amongst the major powers extend beyond politics and permeate trade, investment, and technology.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Global companies are rethinking and reorganising global production and supply chains.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Some companies are reviewing the need for regional hubs in favour of a single global headquarters, and while other manufacturers may decentralise operations to strengthen their resilience.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: All these present challenges and opportunities for Singapore's position as a hub for regional headquarters, high-technology manufacturing activities, and modern services.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our workers will also become more exposed to global competition.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: COVID-19 has shown that remote working and automation are possible.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Singaporeans can thus seize global opportunities out of Singapore, but our jobs are conversely more open to competition from abroad.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: MTI stands ready to take Singapore forward in this changed world.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: To enable the safe resumption of international travel, we will continue to facilitate safe long-term and short-term business travel.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: This will help our businesses and workers tap on international opportunities and create good jobs.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: MTI will also help our businesses and workers adapt.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Some sectors still see growth opportunities, including biomedical sciences, electronics, financial services, and the digital economy.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will help companies in these sectors invest and expand, which will generate business for other companies and ultimately create good jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Other sectors are facing a fall in demand but will eventually recover, such as aerospace, and marine and offshore.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will preserve core capabilities that were painstakingly built up over many years, which will help these sectors remain competitive and recover quickly from this crisis.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will channel support to help companies in these sectors generate fresh revenue and become more cost efficient.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: There are also sectors that have permanently changed, including mass market tourism and social entertainment.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will help them reinvent themselves and pivot to new markets and products.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Where tough decisions are taken by businesses to cease operations or retrench workers, we will partner the Ministry of Manpower and our tripartite partners to help workers develop new skills and find new jobs, and to preserve the Singapore core of skills and capabilities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: To this end, we will implement new programmes that boost business investment, support local entrepreneurship, strengthen balance sheets, and incentivise hiring, ultimately creating more good jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: MTI will continue to strengthen our business environment to enable businesses and workers to seize opportunities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: To preserve Singapore's ability to create jobs for our people, we will strengthen our links with the world for markets, supplies, technology, and talent.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will work with like-minded partners internationally to reaffirm our shared commitment to keeping trade routes open and ensuring the continued flow of goods between Singapore and our partners.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will break new ground with Digital Economy Agreements to facilitate trade in the digital economy, providing ease and certainty to companies, and better enabling technology companies to manage their global platforms and digital services out of Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will develop multi-modal transport solutions to offer new competitive advantages to traders and logistics players using Singapore as a hub.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: This improved connectivity will also enable companies to diversify their supply sources and reach more customers more readily, increasing their resilience against the risk of supply chain disruption.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will also strengthen our existing toolkit to support businesses.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: For example, we will help Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) strengthen their capabilities, and work through intermediaries such as Trade Associations and Chambers (TACs), SME Centres, and the Heartland Enterprise Centre to reach out to the community.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will strengthen support for our startups through Startup SG and the Global Innovation Alliance, and promote internationalisation through programmes like Scale-Up SG to groom more Singapore companies to go global.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will invest in research and innovation to help businesses and workers seize new opportunities, and strengthen our pro-enterprise business environment.
